name: v10_utf16_key_order
description: Object keys MUST be sorted by UTF-16 code unit, per RFC 8785 section 3.2.3, not by Unicode code point. The two orders agree across the whole BMP and disagree above it: U+1F600 encodes to the surrogate pair D83D DE00, so it sorts below U+FF01 in UTF-16 and above it by code point. An implementation using code-point order still produces equal hashes for both payloads below, so the expected hash is what distinguishes it, not the equality.

expected.note: Correct UTF-16 ordering places the astral keys before the BMP ones: U+1F600 before U+FF01, and U+1F680 before U+FFFD in the nested object. Python's sorted() and json.dumps(sort_keys=True) order by code point and will produce a different hash here; JavaScript's Array.prototype.sort is already UTF-16. This vector exists because the two reference SDKs disagreed on exactly this input and no other vector contains a character outside the BMP.
